title: Cost Signal Orchestra: Initiative tracker for dynamic batching, cache & quantization experiments
creator: Ava Patel
description: This ticket coordinates a cross-functional initiative to run tightly instrumented experiments that combine adaptive batching, KV-prefix caching, and selective quantization to reduce hosted token costs while preserving P95 latency SLOs and output quality. The goal is a reusable orchestration and measurement pattern (the 'Orchestra') that product, eng, and SRE can reuse to roll out cost-saving policies safely.
goals: Establish a canonical experiment template that composes batching, prefix KV caching and dynamic quant gating
Achieve >=15% token-cost reduction on targeted workloads without >5% regression in QA evals
Build dashboards and alerting for cost, latency SLOs, and quality drift tied to prompt cohorts
Document rollout playbook and guardrails for canary -> staged rollout across Dedicated/Hosted
acceptance_criteria: Experiment template committed: config schema + CI checks + canary policy
Dashboard panels: cost-per-request, P50/P95 latency, quality-regression by cohort
Two field trials completed (search-snippets and customer-chat) with observability artifacts
Runbook published with rollback criteria and estimated monthly savings extrapolated
Cross-team sign-off: Eng, SRE, Platform Security, Product
tasks: Design config schema for tiered profiles (Thrift/Standard/Accuracy)
Implement server-side dynamic quant gating prototype (ENG-32411)
Create canary orchestration: percent rollout, auto-fallback rules
Build cost/quality dashboards and add to Console shared dashboards
Run two 2-week field trials and aggregate results into summary deck
